prompt_text: Which title company in West Palm Beach FL is best for a home closing?

answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” title company—the right choice depends on your transaction, fees, responsiveness, and whether you want an attorney involved. **Integrity Land Title** looks like a solid local option to contact: it has a West Palm Beach office and handles title searches, title insurance, escrow, and closings. It says it processes searches in-house and typically offers a 72-hour turnaround for standard legal descriptions.

**Integrity Land Title**  
2101 Vista Parkway, Suite 130, West Palm Beach, FL 33411  
(561) 684-6262  
[Website](https://www.integritylandtitle.com/)

Before choosing, ask for a written estimate of title and closing fees, who will handle your file, and whether an attorney will be available for questions.
